subject: physics
question_text: Write the dimensional formulae of work, power and pressure.

recall_prompt: Say the steps you would write for this answer, in order. You can speak in English, in Telugu, or in both.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Work and power
steps.why: Power is work divided by time, so its dimensional formula is the work formula with one more power of T in the denominator. Deriving it makes the −3 impossible to misremember.
common_mistakes: Writing power as [M L² T⁻²], which is work — the extra T⁻¹ is missing.

recall.must_convey: That work is M L squared T to the minus two and power is M L squared T to the minus three.
accept: M L squared T minus two
M L squared T minus three
reject: M L T minus two for work

steps.memory_tip: Power is work per second, so it is work with one extra T in the bottom: T⁻³.
steps.margin_note: Derive, do not recall. Each line is one definition.

steps.label: Pressure
lines: Stress and Young’s modulus share this formula.
steps.why: The L⁻¹ comes from dividing by an area, which is why pressure is the only one of the three with a negative power of length.
common_mistakes: Writing [M L⁻² T⁻²] by dividing by L² twice.

recall.must_convey: That pressure is M L to the minus one T to the minus two.
accept: M L minus one T minus two
reject: M L minus two T minus two

steps.memory_tip: Force ÷ area takes L away twice from the L in force: L¹⁻² = L⁻¹.
steps.margin_note: Note that stress shares this formula — it saves work later.

insider_note: Derive each from its definition in one line. A remembered formula that is wrong earns nothing; a derived one is self-checking.
